claims.head: The Sharks want Wennberg head to head with Pastrnak
claims.call: The Sharks’ L1 (Wennberg, Sherwood and Stenberg) spends at least 62% of its 5-on-5 time against the Bruins’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Sharks keep sending Wennberg’s line (Wennberg, Sherwood and Stenberg) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would. Strength on strength, and Ryan Warsofsky is choosing it. Tonight the Bruins’ first line is Pastrnak, Zacha and Geekie.
claims.nums: At home: 62% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 35% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Ryan Warsofsky likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Bruins’ first line.
